McKesson and private equity firm Clayton, Dubilier & Rice are close to sealing a deal for medical infusion services provider Option Care Health
that values that company at over $5B, including debt.
Option Care Health is in advanced discussions regarding the joint bid, people familiar with the talks told the
Option Care operates 184 care centers and also provides at-home infusion specialty drugs.
Terms call for CD&R to have a 51% stake, with McKesson holding the remainder. McKesson has the right to eventually purchase CD&R's stake.
Option Care Health is up ~22% in after-hours trading, while McKesson is flat.

title: McKesson, CD&R in talks for $5B deal for Option Care Health: FT
